custodianAssessment: Kent County is the evidenced local county parcel-map custodian for Grand Rapids, through its Property Description and Mapping Division and public GIS/iMap viewer. Michigan DTMB was recorded only as general state agency context, not as the local custodian.
queryAndRequestOutcome: See city record requestOutcomes. The public viewer configuration and ArcGIS layer schema were followed to the anonymous REST service. Exact WUP point returned one local parcel identity; a 0.02-degree envelope returned three polygons and indicated more records via exceededTransferLimit.

nativeSchema.geometry: esriGeometryPolygon; response exported as GeoJSON-compatible rings with EPSG:4326 coordinates
nativeSchema.nativeIdentity: PNUM string parcel number, with PPN numeric parcel number corroboration; OBJECTID is an ArcGIS service OID
nativeSchema.retainedPropertiesPolicy: Each retained feature has exactly {"id": PNUM}; no raw source attribute set retained.
nativeSchema.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key used; PNUM is the stable native parcel-number identity. PPN was used only as corroboration during inspection.

scopeLimits: Bounded anonymous requests only; no citywide enumeration or completeness claim.
The exact-point hit cannot be used as absence/presence evidence for the whole city.
The sample envelope is centered on the supplied WUP point and is not a municipal boundary query.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.

retainedSample.geometryStatus: full unchanged native polygon rings from the bounded ArcGIS response; output CRS EPSG:4326

uncertainty: The county viewer and layer are usable anonymous public sources, but this packet does not qualify an adapter, guarantee current completeness, or authorize runtime admission.
